review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Req.: 12–14 Years Preference for early joiners (within 30 days) Requirements: Bachelor’s in Computer Science, IT, ECE or a related field. 12–14 years of hands-on experience in network consulting, advisory, design, & implementation. Deep expertise in key network protocols: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VLANs, VxLAN, VPNs, etc. Strong expertise in cloud networking across public cloud such as Azure, AWS & GCP, including hands-on experience like VNet peering, Transit Gateway, VPN Gateway, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute & cloud-native firewalls. Good understanding of SASE technologies Proficiency in network security : Firewalls, IDS/IPS, Load Balancers. Modern Network Practices: Strong hands-on experience with SD-WAN, network virtualization, cloud networking, SDDC, SDN & network automation.
